whisker-street 0.1.2: Meoweconomy mining pass, docs only: the roadmap's standing context gains the telemetry dossier (message income gated by a database-timestamp cooldown, voice income paying a flat rate to muted and AFK members from an in-memory set with no mute/deafen/AFK handling, the two streams interfering through one shared cooldown timestamp, and no per-member time-series anywhere in 26 tables) with the feed-off verdict those facts force: its counters seed and cross-check our prices; they cannot replace the dedicated collector.

whisker-street 0.1.1: Research pass, docs only: every stock bot in the genre mined (SocialStocks and the Codeforces bot deep-read from `.study/`; Discord-Exchange, Stonkscord, MemberMarket, Channel Stonks, Whale Street, WabbitBot, Dank Memer, and Empire Avenue distilled into the roadmap's mined-corpus and literature sections).

whisker-street 0.1.0: Initial skeleton: package layout with the engine core stubs (market clock, tuning parameters) and their tests, the spec contract (activity index, IPO seeding, market-maker pools, brokerage invariants, the meoweconomy bridge gate), and a roadmap written as self-contained per-phase briefs so any agent can pick up a phase without conversation pretext.
